delivery: Review build imports the published source plus a test-only bridge to the existing R3F renderer and production simulation. Live URL unavailable to test browser. Geometry, materials, lighting and CSS unchanged; same named fonts supplied from Fontsource packages. Animation endpoints are sought using the production simulation function and rendered with its settled camera for repeatable stills. Not a hardware-performance test.
